Skill/MCP: Source review only; no tool needed.  
Spec: Identify source-proven mobile design/accessibility defects.  
Verification: Check declared CSS against WCAG thresholds at 390×844.

Task: Mobile accessibility review  
Decision: Proceed

- **Insufficient text contrast:** `<p class="contrast-low">` uses `color: #aaa` on `background: #fff`, producing approximately **2.32:1** contrast. The 16px normal-weight text requires at least **4.5:1** under WCAG AA (1.4.3). Darken the text to approximately `#767676` or darker.

No other actionable defects are evident from the source.
